messages:
maria: quick ask — i'm assembling a short observability checklist for the infra handoff. can someone point me to the single-source dashboards/traces for GPU SM%, GPU memory, KV-cache hit/eviction, and batch-size distribution?
ken: grafana GPU overview: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/gpu_overview (SM% + batch histograms). KV-specific dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kvcache_metrics (hit rate, evictions, mem).
ken: for traces use Tempo UI: https://tempo.internal/redwood/search. filter: service=runtime-inference, and tag node=gpu-*.
jasper: when you look at batch impact, try this promql to split by configured batch size label: 
```
avg_over_time(gpu_sm_utilization[5m]) by (instance, job, batch_size)
```
that reveals whether small batches are causing SM churn.
sofia: also add the KV-cache allocation vs. working-set panel — we had an eviction spike last Tue correlated with a config rollout. mem graph: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/kvcache_mem
maria: panel embed ids? want to screenshot/embed in doc.
oliver: pull ids from dashboard API: GET /api/dashboards/uid/gpu_overview -> panels[]. id 22=SM%, 24=batch-size-hist, 31=GPU-mem. kvcache_metrics panel id 18=KV-hit, 19=evictions. append ?panelId=22 to share link.
jasper: for focused traces, set span filter http.path~"/v1/generate" and group by gpu_id. sampling tip: set trace.sampling=0.2 for dense traffic windows.
infra-bot: ALERT gpu-sm-util-high fired 2025-06-03T15:02Z — see runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/gpu-sm-utilization
maria: thx. also, are current alert thresholds still 90% for 5m? wondering if we should nudge to 92% or change window.
oliver: current is 90% for 5m P95 on SM%. i'm thinking: 92% for 5m AND add a suppression rule during canary deploys and autoscaler churn. will draft PR for alert-manager.
sofia: +1 to suppression for canary tags. and add an annotation pointing to the KV eviction dashboard so oncall can correlate quickly.
jasper: small FYI: SM% can be misleading on very low-util GPUs when batching is sparse. prefer using p99 of token throughput alongside SM%.
maria: action items i'm putting in the doc: 1) list grafana/tempo links (maria) 2) screenshot panels + embed ids (maria) 3) oliver to open alert threshold PR (oliver) 4) infra (ken/sofia) to validate KV eviction baseline and note any recent rollouts (ken/sofia).
deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-06-03T15:20Z completed on canary-gpu-2 — telemetry tagged with `deploy=canary-2025-06-03`.
oliver: will take the alert PR today, aim to include a canary suppression window and link to runbook.
maria: perfect, i'll circulate the checklist when screenshots and panel ids are in. thanks all. closing thread unless something else pops up :raised_hands:
